Quinn-proto 0.11.19
Source https://static.crates.io/crates/quinn-proto/quinn-proto-0.11.19.crate
SHA-256 0e750cca55fe4f0439a15d0bb529da9651e79993e8e72c61a899a36d462befbe

h3-quinn 0.0.10
Source https://static.crates.io/crates/h3-quinn/h3-quinn-0.0.10.crate
SHA-256 8b2e732c8d91a74731663ac8479ab505042fbf547b9a207213ab7fbcbfc4f8b4
Local change passes classified bidirectional streams and any consumed prefix to
the existing HTTP/3 driver. Hysteria uses it to handle HTTP and raw streams on one
QUIC connection.

The original package licenses are included. Chrome QUIC compatibility follows the
MIT-licensed github.com/apernet/quic-go v0.61.1-0.20260806010916-184d081eef3e
used by Xray 26.10.31. Hysteria rate negotiation and BBR profile values follow
Xray 26.10.31 a4a3dff.
